scripts.start: if command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3.12 scripts/start-all.py; elif [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/start-all.py; else python3 scripts/start-all.py; fi
scripts.dev: if command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3.12 scripts/start-all.py; elif [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/start-all.py; else python3 scripts/start-all.py; fi
scripts.dev:all: if command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3.12 scripts/start-all.py; elif [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/start-all.py; else python3 scripts/start-all.py; fi
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:python && npm run test:go
scripts.test:all: npm run test:ui && npm run test:python && npm run test:go
scripts.test:python: if command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3.12 scripts/run-python-tests.py; elif [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/run-python-tests.py; else python3 scripts/run-python-tests.py; fi
